newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria fills vacancies in ruling military council.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria fills vacancies in ruling military council.

text.p: Military ruler General Sani Abacha swore in two new members of the provisional ruling council in the capital Abuja on Monday, state radio reported.

They are Major-General Abdullahi Muktar, recently named the commander of the 1st mechanised division of the army based in Kaduna, northern Nigeria, and Brigadier-General Peter Shaa, who became commander of the 3rd armoured division based in Jos, north-central Nigeria.
Muktar's predecessor, Brigadier-General Olayinka Sule retired from the army last year while that of Shaa, Brigadier-General Abubakar Dada, died after a brief illness last year.
State radio said the two men were sworn in before the all-military council began meeting to approve the 1997 fiscal budget, widely expected to be made public by Abacha this week.
